**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Leaf underside view, green with prominent venation
- Dense scatter of small reddish-orange/brown pustules across the entire leaf surface
- White cottony/fluffy clusters interspersed among the pustules
- Pattern consistent with sporulating structures on the abaxial leaf surface

**Key observations:**
- The small reddish-brown dots are characteristic uredia (rust pustules) of soybean rust (*Phakopsora pachyrhizi*)
- Pustules appear on the underside — the classic presentation for soybean rust
- The white fluffy material likely represents mature/ruptured uredinia releasing spores
- Density and distribution across veins matches soybean rust reference (upper-right panel shows similar orange-tan pustules on the underside)

The reference image for Soybean_rust confirms the pattern: small raised pustules on the abaxial leaf surface with orange-tan coloration, matching the test image well.
